3293-5721-6620-8345.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5721-6620-8345.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5721-6620-8345.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1329-3363-5330.easyPrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-3363-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing The One Ring, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

3129-4247-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3129-4247-5254.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

2749-3629-8089.easyPrerequisites: Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
2749-3629-8089.description:
Activate Wall of Blood by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1981-2415-4716-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4716-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

654-3129-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3478-6628-7857.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

2034-4068-6723-6970-7850.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2034-4068-6723-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

413-849-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
413-849-2946-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Anax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

5078-5849-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

4050-5508--5.description:

When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the persist creature.
Repeat

1170-2440-5115-7528.description:
Cast the copy of Awaken the Ages from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Strife Scholar, which enters prepared.
When Strife Scholar enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
When the tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers for each of them, adding a total of at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {R} to repeat steps 1 through 5 an additional time, this time adding nine {C}.
Activate Gemstone Array by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat steps 1 through 5 and step 7 any number of times.

206-1171-1409.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

1976-4331-4993-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

323-5170-5686-6132.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2058-2073-6797.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Flayer Husk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Flayer Husk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Flayer Husk to it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Flayer Husk.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

586-2438-3771-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
586-2438-3771-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

647-1379-3259-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-1379-3259-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

692-1183-4613-4659.notablePrerequisites: Wildwood Mentor has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
692-1183-4613-4659.description:
Activate Wildwood Mentor using Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature token.
When the Pentavite enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pentavite, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Pentavites.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Wildwood Mentor using Pentavus's last ability any number of times.

112-565-1283-2719.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {4}, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens using their second abilities, or target any other permanent.

856-2034-4231-5267.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding {C}{C}.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' first ability triggers, creating a Clue, a Food, and a Treasure token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

600-4772.description:
Cast Jace by paying {1}{U}{U}. Jace enters the battlefield with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season
Activate Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating four nonlegendary copies of Jace that enter the battlefield with six loyalty counters each due to Doubling Season.
Repeat step 2 using a Jace token.
600-4772.notes: Once you have infinite Jace tokens, you may activate their second loyalty abilities by removing two loyalty counters from them, creating infinite 2/2 Illusion creature tokens.
